items.title: Roche Holding (SWX:ROP) Secures FDA Nod For Wilserdly And Expands Lab Testing Reach
items.summary: Roche Holding (SWX:ROP) received US FDA approval for Wilserdly (giredestrant) as an oral therapy for advanced ER-positive, ESR1-mutated breast cancer. The decision supports use of Wilserdly as part of an all-oral SERD combination regimen for patients with hormone-resistant disease. The FDA also granted De Novo authorization for Roche's cobas pro i 601 platform, extending automated mass spectrometry into routine clinical laboratories.
